defs.def: all the people living together in a house or flat/apartment 一家人；家庭；同住一所（或一套）房子的人adj.

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.
ex.t: 不过在这个过程中我也学到了一些东西，希望如果你也在尽力想办法在一个不太支持的家庭环境中做出改变，这些经验能给你带来鼓励。

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的个人空间有一些控制权来做你想做的改变。

ex.s: As you make your lifestyle changes, you may find yourself wanting to speak up for yourself if others comment on what you’re doing, which can turn itself into a whole household debate.
ex.t: 当你改变生活方式时，如果别人对你的做法评头论足，你可能想为自己发声，这可能演变成一场家庭辩论。

ex.s: How to live a zero waste lifestyle in a household.
ex.t: 如何在家庭中实践零浪费生活方式。

ex.s: Age isn't the only factor; I'd say it's also to do with the makeup of your household.
ex.t: 年龄不是唯一的因素；我想这与你的家庭成员构成也有关系。

ex.s: I’m glad you will be contributing to the household." My dad’s words made me realize that my earnings might not be mine to do with as I wished.
ex.t: 我很高兴你能为家庭做出贡献。"爸爸的话让我意识到我的收入可能不能由我自己支配。

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: It is said that about 20% of 25-34-year-olds live with their parents, compared with 16% in 1991.The total number of all multigenerational households in Britain is thought to be about 1.8 million.
ex.t: 据说大约20%的25-34岁年轻人与父母住在一起，而1991年这一比例为16%。英国所有多代同堂家庭的总数估计约为180万。

ex.s: With food our biggest weekly household expense, Susanna and Matt spend time with a different family each week.
ex.t: 食物是我们每周最大的家庭开支，苏珊娜和马特每周都会花时间与不同的家庭在一起。

ex.s: The average number of electronic devices rose from four per household in 1992 to 13 in 2007.
ex.t: 电子设备的平均数量从1992年的每户4台增加到了2007年的13台。

ex.s: The budget line is an elementary concept that most consumers understand intuitively without a need for graphs and equations — it's the household budget, for example.
ex.t: 预算线是一个基本概念，大多数消费者无需图表和方程式就能直观理解——例如家庭预算。

ex.s: Be prepared to be corrected by student B The classification of household waste aims to help people separate different types of waste.
ex.t: 准备好在学生B纠正你。垃圾分类的目的是帮助人们区分不同类型的垃圾。

ex.s: Household waste can be roughly divided into: food waste non-recyclable waste recyclable waste.
ex.t: 生活垃圾大致可以分为：餐厨垃圾、不可回收垃圾、可回收垃圾。

ex.s: Including paper, glass, plastic and used batteries China plans to introduce household waste classification and sorting in the first batch of cities by 2020.
ex.t: 包括纸张、玻璃、塑料和废旧电池，中国计划在2020年前在首批城市推行生活垃圾分类。

ex.s: The first batch of cities to introduce household waste classification and sorting includes Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Chongqing and all capitals of provinces and autonomous regions.
ex.t: 首批推行生活垃圾分类的城市包括北京、上海、天津、重庆以及所有省会城市和自治区首府。

ex.s: Because I contribute to the household bills and my commute to work is quite expensive, I find it hard to save any money.
ex.t: 因为我需要分担家庭账单，加上通勤费用相当昂贵，我发现很难存下任何钱。
